product_one_liner.value: Quantum Metric is an AI-powered digital experience analytics platform that helps enterprise product, engineering, analytics, and customer-experience teams understand customer behavior, diagnose friction, and prioritize improvements by business impact.

pricing_page.notes: Public enterprise-plan page explains included capabilities and pricing factors; quotes are customized rather than published as fixed prices.

eng_blog.notes: The current company blog index contains product, digital-analytics, and customer-experience content, rather than a verified engineering publication. Historical technical articles by an employee on his personal Medium account were found, but a company engineering blog with two accessible posts could not be established.

public_docs.notes: The docs subdomain serves the marketing homepage, the SDK site requires sign-in, and the community/help material checked was gated; no public multi-article product documentation portal was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists seven openings, none with a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The company describes Felix AI as powered by Gemini Pro. Its subprocessor list updated 2026-10-09 names Google for in-platform AI; Anthropic and OpenAI are listed for internal support/development/analysis and possible future in-platform features, not confirmed current product model providers.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001 are explicitly claimed in the company’s July 2021 announcement; current renewal was not independently established. GDPR is a publicly claimed compliance status, not a certification standard.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding round is the January 2021 Series B, before the 2025-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window; no newer round was found.

launched_6mo.notes: Quantum Metric MCP became generally available on 2026-10-22, within the 2026-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: CMO Efrat Ravid announced her departure from the executive role on 2026-01-05, while remaining an advisor; her announcement also identifies Caitlin Tucker as her successor.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live Enterprise Account Executive posting explicitly names Salesforce as an example of CRM proficiency required; this is a hiring-stack signal, not proof of exclusive CRM deployment.
